description:
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting eight +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Hoverguard Sweepers spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler eight times by removing eight +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
